calculate_mass_transfer_lv uses the RAW (T_l - T_sat); Stadtke clamps it with max(.,0) so a SUBCOOLED (stable) liquid contributes nothing.

Superheated vapour + subcooled liquid: BOTH phases stable, so Stadtke's closure gives sigma_Mg = 0 identically. The unclamped code returns a finite rate whose sign is set by whichever raw dT term is larger.
